title: Illusion minion
problem: Illusion minion: +2 Artifact attack rolls when the ATTACKER has Illusion (code tested the target)

release_notes.intended: The master's post-action effects (on-attack and so on) activate 2 additional times.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, for the master's Artifact on-attack effects, the game checked whether the target had an Illusion instead of the attacker.
release_notes.fix: Now the attacker's Illusion gives its Artifact on-attack effects the 2 extra activations.
